abstract: PURPOSE: The aim of the study was to examine the clinical presentation, method(s) of treatment, complications, and results in newborns and infants with retroperitoneal germ cell tumors (GCTs). METHODS: A retrospective chart review of all patients treated between 1974 and 2002 for GCT located in the retroperitoneum in 2 institutions identified 12 patients with histologically proven retroperitoneal GCT. Vital data concerning pregnancy and delivery were analyzed. Age at diagnosis and symptoms were recorded, as well as possibly associated anomalies. Data concerning surgical treatment, perioperative and postoperative complications, histological staging, and final outcome were all analyzed. RESULTS: In 3 patients, the diagnosis had been made antenatally between 31 and 35 weeks of gestation. In 1 patient, the diagnosis was made at birth, and in 8 later in life (ages 3, 5, 7, 8, 8, 11, 18, and 24 months). Symptoms in these 8 boys and 4 girls were abdominal distension and a palpable upper abdominal mass, right-sided in 5, left-sided in 5, and central in 2; the tumor was usually big. Associated anomalies were noted in 4 patients and were chromosomal in 3 (Down syndrome in 2 and Klinefelter syndrome in 1). One baby died of uncontrollable bleeding during an emergency operation immediately after traumatic birth. The other 11 infants survived. Four other patients showed serious perioperative complications (1 caval vein tear, 1 choledochal tear, 1 cyst rupture, and 1 esophagogastric tear) which were managed without further consequences. Histologically, 4 tumors were mature teratomas, 6 were immature teratomas (grade I in 4, grade II in 1, and grade II-III in 1), and 2 were malignant yolk sac tumors (YSTs). The patients with YSTs underwent surgical biopsy, followed by chemotherapy and excision of the remaining tumor and of the metastases. No adjuvant treatment was administered in the patients with benign disease. Nine survivors with benign tumor are disease-free between 1 and 30 years after surgery. Two patients with YST have now been in remission for 6 and 5 years, respectively. CONCLUSIONS: Both this study and the literature review performed testify to the extreme rarity of GCTs in the retroperitoneum. Surgical removal of the tumors appeared to be hazardous because of the extent of the tumor, the displacement and elongation of adjacent structures and organs, and/or the adhesion of the tumor to surrounding tissues; this resulted in several perioperative complications. The long-term results are good, however, with 9 of 10 patients with benign tumors in good health after a mean follow-up of 12 years, and with the 2 patients with YST in remission for 6 and 5 years, respectively.
abstract_ja: 目的：新生児および乳児の後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍（GCT）における臨床像、治療法、合併症、治療成績を検討すること。方法：1974年から2002年の間に2施設で後腹膜GCTと組織学的に確定され治療された12例を同定し、後方視的に診療録を検討した。出生に関する情報、診断時年齢と症状、関連する奇形の有無を解析した。外科的治療、周術期および術後の合併症、病理組織学的病期分類、最終転帰を解析した。結果：3例は妊娠31～35週で出生前に診断された。1例は出生時に診断され、8例は生後3、5、7、8、8、11、18、24か月で診断された。男児8例、女児4例で、症状は腹部膨満と上腹部の触知可能な腫瘤であった。腫瘤は右側5例、左側5例、正中2例にみられ、通常は大きかった。関連する奇形は4例にみられ、3例は染色体異常（ダウン症候群2例、クラインフェルター症候群1例）であった。外傷性分娩直後の緊急手術中に制御不能な出血で1例が死亡した。残る11例の乳児は生存した。重篤な周術期合併症が4例にみられた（大静脈裂傷1例、総胆管裂傷1例、嚢胞破裂1例、食道胃裂傷1例）が、いずれも後遺症なく管理された。病理組織学的には、4例が成熟奇形腫、6例が未熟奇形腫（グレードI 4例、グレードII 1例、グレードII-III 1例）、2例が悪性卵黄嚢腫瘍（YST）であった。YST症例は外科的生検の後、化学療法を施行し、残存腫瘍および転移巣を切除した。良性疾患の症例には補助療法を行わなかった。良性腫瘍の生存者9例は、手術後1～30年にわたり無病で経過している。YST症例2例はそれぞれ6年および5年の寛解を維持している。結論：本研究と文献的検討から、後腹膜GCTはきわめてまれであることが確認された。腫瘍の広がり、隣接する構造物や臓器の偏位と伸長、周囲組織との癒着により、外科的切除は危険を伴った。その結果、いくつかの周術期合併症が生じた。しかし長期成績は良好で、平均12年のフォローアップでは良性腫瘍の10例中9例が良好な状態であり、YST 2例はそれぞれ6年および5年の寛解を維持している。
